# PARENTHESES PUZZLE. Copy this file into a topic folder, e.g. topic/pemdas/_parens-3-name.qmd
# The student taps the gaps between symbols to place "(" and ")", then presses Check.
type: parens
# Shown in the slide title and in the results list. LaTeX OK in single quotes.
title: 'Make it equal $x^2$'
# The expression, one symbol per token, separated by spaces. The gaps between tokens
# are where parentheses can go, so write a negative number as two tokens: − 1.
# Allowed: numbers, x, + − · × ÷ ^ ² (use the true minus −).
expression: − 1 · x · − 1 + x + 2 − 2 − 1
# What it must equal. Checked by arithmetic, so every correct placement counts.
target: x²
# Optional: only check at this value of x (default: must be equal for every x).
# x: 2
# Optional: how many pairs of parentheses to place (default 1).
# pairs: 1
---

Tap a gap to place **(**, then a gap to its right to place **)**.
Put one pair of parentheses in $-1 \cdot x \cdot -1 + x + 2 - 2 - 1$ so that it equals $x^2$.

## Hint
First hint (must not give the answer away).

## Solution
**Answer:** $-1 \cdot x \cdot -(1 + x + 2 - 2 - 1)$

Explain why.
